symptom: an architecture-report annotation `unused:FaultProbe` changes nothing; the document stays 'verify' and the key is listed under 'annotations that matched nothing' (ako/PizzaV1 had to rename every key to `unused:Shop.FaultProbe`)
cause: the page looked the key up by the qualified name only, while the unused table and the natural way to write the key both say just the document name
insight: Accept the short key only when the short name is unique among the unused documents; an ambiguous one stays visibly unmatched rather than annotating the wrong document
